name: Kunya-Urgench
description: Kunya-Urgench is a field of ruined mosques, mausoleums and fortress walls in north-western Turkmenistan, near the Uzbek border. It was once the capital of the Khorezm region. Most of the buildings date from the 11th to 16th centuries, and a 60-metre minaret towers over them. The townspeople moved away in the early 1700s, leaving the old city largely undisturbed.
